interface.shortDescription: Understand your facility's air, act and verify.
interface.longDescription: A local open-source operations plugin for connecting equipment, checking fresh evidence and verifying allowed ventilation actions. The demonstration uses virtual physical equipment and actual oneM2M software.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up the openSoom virtual facility.
Inspect the facility's ventilation and verify any permitted action.

request_action.name: request_action
request_action.description: Request a profile-authorized action. Reuse request_id when retrying the same intended action. Server validates freshness and scope. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

discover.name: discover
discover.description: Find accessible facilities and equipment using real oneM2M discovery. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

read_evidence.name: read_evidence
read_evidence.description: Read current observations, freshness, incidents and commands before deciding on an action. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

prepare_setup.name: prepare_setup
prepare_setup.description: Validate an existing facility profile and explain the setup plan without activating it. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

read_group.name: read_group
read_group.description: Query the facility's native oneM2M group and retain each member's result; group success is not device ACK. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

apply_setup.name: apply_setup
apply_setup.description: Apply a validated profile only if this server's fixed identity is already an administrator; never self-grant. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

doctor.name: doctor
doctor.description: Check service/CSE readiness and actionable setup diagnostics without exposing credentials. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

verify_result.name: verify_result
verify_result.description: Independently check command state, device ACK and later observations; report pending/failed/unresolved outcomes as returned. This tool is part of plugin `openSoom`.

limitations: No Codex model turn was executed; this is a host/plugin transport test.
